note: NOTE: branch is basic (starter, available from level 1) or nature / elemental / spiritual. Unlocks: basic from start; nature = level 3 + 5 main-stat points; elemental = level 6 + 10; spiritual = level 8 + 15. Rebalance rationale (to be tuned): basic skills are always available and cheap, so they start weaker and scale slowly (+2%/rank). Category skills start stronger (or add utility) and scale faster (nature +8%, elemental +7%, spiritual +7%) so they overtake basics and stay ahead. Examples: Power Strike 140% (was 180%), Energy Blast 130% (was 160%), Backstab 250% guaranteed crit, crit already baked in (was 400%). Training costs scale by tier: basic < nature < elemental < spiritual, and within a class the stronger skill costs more (e.g. Flame Cleave > Earthbreaker). Each rank still needs materials + essence + coins; rares are milestones at 5 and 10. mp_cost is placeholder MP spent on use. damage_multiplier is a factor (1.4 = 140% of attack). v0 placeholders; may pivot after playtesting.

rows.name: Rage
rows.description: Basic starter buff. Available from level 1. Intentionally modest so category skills feel like an upgrade.

rows.name: Power Strike
rows.description: Basic starter attack. Available from level 1. Rebalanced down from 180% so later skills outpace it (low +2%/rank scaling).

rows.name: Earthbreaker
rows.description: Nature branch, opens early. A ground slam around the warrior. Slightly above Power Strike and hits a group.

rows.name: Flame Cleave
rows.description: Elemental branch, opens mid. A wide flaming swing. Clearly stronger than Earthbreaker; costs more to train.

rows.name: Soul Guard
rows.description: Spiritual branch, opens late. A protective soul shield. Most expensive warrior skill.

rows.name: Energy Shield
rows.effect: +8% defense; attackers take 5% of damage dealt as reflected damage
rows.description: Basic starter buff. Available from level 1. Lasts 2 minutes. Modest so later skills feel stronger.

rows.name: Energy Blast
rows.description: Basic starter attack. Available from level 1. A ranged energy shot. Rebalanced down from 160% so Firebolt and Holy Light pull ahead.

rows.name: Thorn Bind
rows.description: Nature branch, opens early. Vines bind the target in place. Lower raw damage than Energy Blast, but the root is the upgrade.

rows.name: Firebolt
rows.description: Elemental branch, opens mid. A direct fire bolt. Clearly stronger than Energy Blast; costs more than Thorn Bind.

rows.name: Holy Light
rows.effect: 220% AoE damage; heals the caster for 10% of damage dealt
rows.description: Spiritual branch, opens late. A burst of holy light. Capstone mage skill; most expensive to train.

rows.name: Stealth
rows.description: Basic starter buff. Available from level 1. Required to use Backstab.

rows.name: Backstab
rows.effect: 250% damage, guaranteed crit (crit multiplier already included; no extra 1.5x). Only usable during Stealth.
rows.description: Basic starter attack. Available from level 1. Can only be used while Stealth is active. Rebalanced down from 400% so category skills can outpace it at high rank.

rows.name: Venom Strike
rows.description: Nature branch, opens early. A poisoned stab. Repeatable and scales better than Backstab.

rows.name: Lightning Dash
rows.description: Elemental branch, opens mid. A dash that hits each enemy passed through. Stronger than Venom Strike; costs more.

rows.name: Shadow Mark
rows.description: Spiritual branch, opens late. Marks a target so they take more damage. Most expensive rogue skill.
